channel.title: Detroit Sports Nation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Detroit Sports Nation (detroitsportsnation.com)

item.title: Scott Boras Breaks Silence on Skubal Contract Standoff With Tigers
item.description: Scott Boras pushes back on claims talks are over, insisting negotiations remain open with Tarik Skubal despite the Tigers’ file-and-trial approach and looming arbitration.

item.title: Detroit Lions’ New OC Drew Petzing Could Bring a Starting Center With Him
item.description: New Lions OC Drew Petzing could bring familiar faces from Arizona to Detroit. Here are three potential free agents who fit the Lions’ needs, including a starting-caliber center and veteran playmakers.

item.title: Bryce Underwood and Michigan Debut in 2026 Way-Too-Early Top 25
item.description: The Athletic released its way-too-early 2026 college football rankings, and Michigan landed inside the Top 15.

item.title: Dan Campbell Goes ‘Incognito’ At Secretary of State [Photo]
item.description: Detroit Lions head coach Dan Campbell was spotted trying to blend in at a Michigan Secretary of State office, bundled up and masked in a viral “incognito” photo.

item.title: Baker Mayfield Calls Out Kevin Stefanski in Fiery Response on Social Media
item.description: Baker Mayfield took a sharp jab at new Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski after being labeled a “failure” in Cleveland. Now with Tampa Bay, Mayfield can’t wait to face his former coach twice a year.

item.title: Michigan Football Poaches Ernest Nunley From Cal
item.description: Former Cal safety signee Ernest Nunley has committed to Michigan after reopening his recruitment.

item.title: Detroit Tigers Add Former First-Round Pick to Bullpen in Sneaky Depth Move
item.description: The Detroit Tigers have signed veteran right-hander Phil Bickford to a minor league contract, adding experienced depth to their bullpen ahead of the 2026 season.

item.title: Former Michigan Running Back Changes Mind, Will Return to Ann Arbor
item.description: Michigan running back Bryson Kuzdzal is expected to withdraw from the transfer portal and return to Ann Arbor, giving the Wolverines proven depth after a productive 2025 season.

item.title: Alberto Mendoza Makes Quick Portal Move, Announces Where He Will Play in 2026
item.description: Indiana quarterback Alberto Mendoza has signed with Georgia Tech after entering the transfer portal following the Hoosiers’ CFP championship win. He has three years of eligibility remaining.

item.title: Mike McDaniel Is Closing in on a Major Offensive Role
item.description: NFL insider Tom Pelissero reports that if Mike McDaniel becomes an offensive coordinator in 2026, the expectation is that it will be with the Los Angeles Chargers and quarterback Justin Herbert.
